title: Configuration and service scope
requirement: The system SHALL record approved facility, fleet, clinical-service and integration configurations with versioned identities and accountable roles.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: Platform-derived requirement; not inferred from CAD
acceptance_criterion: Review one configuration and reject a module whose required interface or approval record is absent.

title: Clinical workflow
requirement: The system SHALL support authorized registration, encounter, result review and handover with explicit responsible practitioners and workflow states.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: Platform-derived requirement; not inferred from CAD
acceptance_criterion: Complete a synthetic encounter; reject invalid transitions and retain practitioner identity and reviewed result history.

title: Clinical interoperability
requirement: The system SHALL declare selected FHIR versions, profiles, terminology and optional imaging adapters and validate incoming exchanges.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: Platform-derived requirement; not inferred from CAD
acceptance_criterion: Accept selected-profile synthetic messages; reject invalid or unauthorized messages with traceable outcomes.

title: Access and audit
requirement: The system SHALL enforce role and purpose scoped access at clinical APIs and audit authorized and denied access without copying clinical content into fleet telemetry.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: Platform-derived requirement; not inferred from CAD
acceptance_criterion: Deny an unauthorized synthetic record request; log subject, action, outcome and time; inspect operational events for prohibited clinical fields.

title: Hospital and supply operations
requirement: The system SHALL track bed, equipment, inventory and selected supply-chain transitions with revision checks and traceable lot/expiry records where applicable.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: Platform-derived requirement; not inferred from CAD
acceptance_criterion: Reject an outdated revision; reconcile synthetic reservation/release and lot/expiry events without duplicate stock movements.

title: Supervised EMS coordination
requirement: The system SHALL coordinate incident, availability, assignment, transport and handover under qualified dispatch authority, with review before consequential assignment.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: Platform-derived requirement; not inferred from CAD
acceptance_criterion: Replay a synthetic incident through handover; reject an unreviewed assignment and detect an unavailable resource.

title: Operational twin contract
requirement: The system SHALL expose versioned asset/configuration identity, timestamp, units, quality, readiness and fault state through a separate operational data contract.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: Platform-derived requirement; not inferred from CAD
acceptance_criterion: Replay valid, malformed and stale telemetry; validate provenance, mark stale state and preserve clinical-data isolation.

title: Disconnected recovery
requirement: The system SHALL define local workflows, buffering, idempotent replay and conflict resolution for loss and restoration of selected external links.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: Platform-derived requirement; not inferred from CAD
acceptance_criterion: Replay duplicate and out-of-order events after simulated WAN loss; preserve identity and expose unresolved conflicts for authorized review.

title: Governed decision support
requirement: The system SHALL label AI/CQL outputs as proposals with input/model/rule version and authorized human disposition; local helm and clinical authority SHALL remain independent of cloud availability.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: Platform-derived requirement; not inferred from CAD
acceptance_criterion: Reject an unreviewed consequential proposal; retrieve provenance and reviewer disposition; demonstrate continued local authority during AI/link loss.

title: Verification and change control
requirement: The system SHALL link each requirement to configuration, proposed design allocation, verification procedure, result and change impact before release.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: Platform-derived requirement; not inferred from CAD
acceptance_criterion: Inspect full requirement coverage; reject release when required evidence, critical budgets or approved dispositions are missing.

title: Naval loading and stability
requirement: SHALL define displacement, draft, freeboard, mass/CG and stability for each approved occupancy and module loading case.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: All CAD: hull and modular arrangements
acceptance_criterion: Approved loading-case analysis against preselected naval criteria; no dimensions inferred from the illustration.

title: Structure and watertightness
requirement: SHALL define compartmentation, penetrations, structural load paths, module attachments, drainage and corrosion protection.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: All CAD: hull, deck and equipment
acceptance_criterion: Inspect arrangement and review structural/penetration/load evidence for each selected configuration.

title: Patient access and transfer
requirement: SHALL define secure stretcher/equipment retention, boarding, handling, access and emergency egress for the approved occupancy.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: All CAD: patient facilities and access
acceptance_criterion: Demonstrate representative boarding, securing and egress against an approved human-factors plan.

title: Essential energy
requirement: SHALL define protected power, reserve and degraded-load priorities for navigation, medical support, communications and alarms.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: All CAD: energy systems; derived resilience
acceptance_criterion: Review mission energy budget; inject source loss and verify approved essential-load and shutdown behavior.

title: Medical environment and utilities
requirement: SHALL define clean/dirty flows, ventilation, potable/process water, waste and equipment-service access for the selected medical mission.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: All CAD: medical facilities and water/waste
acceptance_criterion: Approve layout, segregation, utility budgets and maintainability criteria before installation.

title: Module interfaces
requirement: SHALL maintain versioned mounting, mass/CG, power/fluid, command/data and service contracts with compatibility and license records.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: All CAD: modular design and open interfaces
acceptance_criterion: Review a module contract and its approved installation/removal plan; identify all affected loading and service budgets.

title: Interoperability scope
requirement: SHALL select clinical exchange versions/profiles and terminology; isolate HIS/FHIR and optional imaging adapters behind validated interfaces.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: README: FHIR/CQL; large-ship CAD: FHIR/DICOM
acceptance_criterion: Test representative exchanges against selected profiles and authorization rules; record incompatible or invalid inputs.

title: Clinical privacy boundary
requirement: SHALL keep clinical records and access audit under dedicated governance; use authorized minimal links in ordinary asset/mission telemetry.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: README governance; derived privacy boundary
acceptance_criterion: Attempt unauthorized clinical access/export through twin and event APIs; deny disclosure and audit authorized access.

title: OpenTwin asset data
requirement: SHALL publish asset/configuration identity, mode, location, energy, equipment readiness, faults and maintenance with timestamps, units and quality.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: All CAD: digital twin dashboards
acceptance_criterion: Replay valid, stale and reconnect datasets; verify field provenance, configuration and approved freshness/error criteria.

title: Communications resilience
requirement: SHALL provide selected marine/local communications and authorized remote monitoring with buffering and defined disconnected workflows.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: All CAD: navigation, communications and telemedicine
acceptance_criterion: Demonstrate WAN loss, reconnection and conflict handling while essential local monitoring/control remains available.

title: Local authority and AI governance
requirement: SHALL retain validated local vessel control and qualified clinical/dispatch authority; record model, input provenance and human review for AI proposals.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: README human oversight; CAD AI assistance
acceptance_criterion: Block unreviewed consequential proposals; verify local safe stop/control during cloud/AI loss and retrieve reviewed decision evidence.

title: Verification and envelope
requirement: SHALL approve mission/environment, device/calibration and recovery criteria; validate models and staged trials before envelope expansion.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: README MBSE; derived engineering gates
acceptance_criterion: Maintain requirement-to-test/evidence traceability and approved entry/exit criteria; no physical or clinical acceptance inferred from simulation.

title: Coastal and river mission
requirement: SHALL define patrol, community access, supervised emergency transport and handover scenarios within a validated coastal/river envelope.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: use cases and reinforced hull
acceptance_criterion: Approve mission and envelope; demonstrate a representative supervised dispatch/transport/handover scenario.
status: External baseline in JFXAI4CBS / evidence pending

title: Twin outboard arrangement
requirement: SHALL define the depicted twin-outboard propulsion arrangement and assess selected fuel/electric/hybrid alternatives without assuming simultaneous implementation.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: twin outboards; fuel/electric hybrid label
acceptance_criterion: Compare selected drive with resistance/energy budget; test steering and local stop for its approved configuration.
status: External baseline in JFXAI4CBS / evidence pending

title: Patient compartment
requirement: SHALL provide an arranged patient area for stretcher retention, selected monitoring and supervised telemedicine with accessible equipment.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: patient area and modular equipment
acceptance_criterion: Inspect stretcher/equipment access and demonstrate transfer and monitoring workflow for approved occupancy.
status: External baseline in JFXAI4CBS / evidence pending

title: Modular working deck
requirement: SHALL define deck equipment/rescue/cargo mounts, retention and clear working/boarding routes with controlled mass/CG.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: modular deck
acceptance_criterion: Review load/mount records and inspect access for each selected rescue/cargo configuration.
status: External baseline in JFXAI4CBS / evidence pending

title: Solar and protected power
requirement: SHALL define roof PV and its protected conversion interface to the selected vessel energy system.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: solar panels
acceptance_criterion: Approve mounting/shading and power budget; test isolated charging and essential-load priority.
status: External baseline in JFXAI4CBS / evidence pending

title: Navigation and communications
requirement: SHALL integrate selected GPS/GNSS, AIS, radar/cameras, VHF and optional cellular/satellite communications with local helm indication.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: radar/navigation and communications
acceptance_criterion: Replay sensor/link faults; verify validity, operator status and approved degraded response.
status: External baseline in JFXAI4CBS / evidence pending

title: Water and waste
requirement: SHALL provide separate fresh, grey and black water circuits/tanks with service access and approved capacities.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: water/waste
acceptance_criterion: Inspect independent circuits and demonstrate leakage/level response against the approved mission budgets.
status: External baseline in JFXAI4CBS / evidence pending

title: Configurable vessel mission
requirement: SHALL define consultation, emergency support, laboratory, vaccination and telemedicine configurations with approved occupancy and crew roles.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: medical facilities and use cases
acceptance_criterion: Review configuration/CONOPS; demonstrate workflow and boarding for a selected configuration.

title: Medical modules
requirement: SHALL define replaceable medical-module installation, retention, utility connections and servicing without conflicting access/egress.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: modular medical vessel and deck modules
acceptance_criterion: Approve module load/CG and services; inspect installed arrangement and replacement access.

title: Helipad interface
requirement: SHALL treat the illustrated helipad as a separately engineered medevac/logistics interface with aircraft loads, clearances and operating limits.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: helipad
acceptance_criterion: Approve aircraft/platform compatibility, structural/environment limits and authorized operating procedures before activation.

title: Rescue/support boats
requirement: SHALL define stowage, handling, launching/recovery and safe patient-transfer interfaces for selected support boats.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: rescue/support boats and crane
acceptance_criterion: Review handling/load/exclusion plan and demonstrate authorized recovery/transfer under defined conditions.

title: Hybrid and solar option
requirement: SHALL define the selected hybrid propulsion/energy arrangement and roof PV without inferring a fuel chemistry from the illustration.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: hybrid propulsion and solar
acceptance_criterion: Approve drive/source selection and energy/thermal/load analysis; demonstrate source fault and essential-load response.

title: Navigation and mission coordination
requirement: SHALL provide local navigation with selected GPS/GNSS, AIS and radar, plus reviewed AI assistance and mission status.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: advanced navigation and AI assistance
acceptance_criterion: Replay sensor/AI loss and verify qualified review plus local helm and mission indications.

title: Water and waste utilities
requirement: SHALL define fresh-water filtration and waste-treatment interfaces sized for selected clinical and accommodation loads.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: water/waste systems
acceptance_criterion: Review independent fluid routes, approved quality/capacity criteria and service access.

title: Remote healthcare and twin
requirement: SHALL support authorized telemedicine and operational twin analytics through distinct clinical and asset data paths.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: medical services and dashboard
acceptance_criterion: Demonstrate remote session/link loss and asset telemetry without exposing patient data through fleet dashboards.

title: Large support-ship mission
requirement: SHALL define humanitarian, disaster-response and outreach configurations with passenger/patient/crew and logistics loading records.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: mission labels and accommodation
acceptance_criterion: Approve mission/configuration and occupancy/loading budgets; inspect arrangement and access for selected roles.

title: Advanced clinical facilities
requirement: SHALL evaluate illustrated emergency, surgery, ICU, laboratory, pharmacy, maternity and telemedicine facilities as separately approved clinical modules.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: modular facilities and advanced care panel
acceptance_criterion: Approve clinical scope, staff/equipment, layout, utilities and qualification evidence for each activated service.

title: Patient accommodation
requirement: SHALL define configurable accommodation, transfers, accessibility and evacuation routes matched to approved occupancy and clinical scope.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: patient accommodation
acceptance_criterion: Inspect arrangement and demonstrate representative transfer/egress against a clinically reviewed plan.

title: Bridge and command
requirement: SHALL provide local navigation, communications and mission coordination under defined bridge and clinical responsibilities.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: bridge and command center
acceptance_criterion: Demonstrate operational coordination and control continuity under sensor/link faults using an approved responsibility table.

title: Logistics and cargo
requirement: SHALL define modular cargo, supplies and vehicle/container interfaces with retention, loading records and cold-chain/expiry controls where applicable.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: logistics/cargo and humanitarian panel
acceptance_criterion: Verify cargo mass/CG, retention and records; inspect cold-chain/expiry acceptance for selected supplies.

title: Helipad and support boats
requirement: SHALL engineer independent helipad and boat handling/transfer interfaces with approved loads, access, exclusion zones and operating limits.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: helipad and rescue/support boats
acceptance_criterion: Approve aircraft/boat compatibility and handling plans; demonstrate only operations whose entry criteria are satisfied.

title: Energy variants and renewables
requirement: SHALL assess illustrated LNG/biofuel/electric-ready propulsion alternatives and PV against mission demand and essential reserves.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: hybrid propulsion and solar
acceptance_criterion: Record selected sources and their mass/thermal/energy impacts; verify reserve and fault behavior without claiming all variants are installed.

title: Water and waste plant
requirement: SHALL define filtration/desalination/treatment candidates and separate potable, process and waste interfaces for mission/hotel/clinical demand.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: water and waste systems
acceptance_criterion: Approve source/quality/capacity and discharge criteria; verify selected process and service access against the defined specification.

title: Clinical and mission exchange
requirement: SHALL select authorized FHIR, optional DICOM imaging and mission/geospatial adapters with explicit versions, profiles and permissions.
cad_callout_or_derived_basis: CAD: HL7 FHIR, DICOM, OGC/OSM examples
acceptance_criterion: Run authorized synthetic clinical/imaging/mission exchange tests; verify invalid-profile rejection and privacy separation.
